name: Dagger of the Winter Wonderland
body:
Aura faint conjuration; CL 7th; Price 11,342 gp; Weight 1 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

This strange poniard resembles a carrot perpetually glazed in frost.

It functions as a +1 dagger but allows the bearer to cast dimension door once per day provided they are standing on a patch of snow and reappear on a patch of snow within 360 ft. In addition, the bearer receives a +2-enhancement bonus to all saving throws made against any cold effects or damage.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor; Spells dimension door, endure elements; Cost 5,322 gp
